# Prague Post

> Prague Post is a lifestyle and business publication covering expat living, remote work, fashion, food, and consumer wellness topics.

Prague Post serves the Prague expat community and international audience with curated guides on lifestyle, business, fashion, and dining. The publication emphasizes practical advice for remote workers, digital nomads, and those relocating to Prague.

## Key Topics

- Prague
- Expat lifestyle
- Remote work
- Digital nomads
- Fashion & style
- Lifestyle guides
- Dental health
- Jewelry & accessories
- Food & drink
- Pet ownership
- Business news
- Urban living
- Consumer wellness

## Lifestyle & Wellness

- [Lifestyle - Prague Post](https://www.praguepost.com/lifestyle): Prague Post lifestyle section covering dental health and consumer topics
- [Invisalign vs Braces: Which Is the Best Choice for You?](https://www.praguepost.com/lifestyle/invisalign-vs-braces-which-is-best-choice-for-you): Comparison guide for Invisalign and braces orthodontic treatment options
- [Special Occasions Lab-Grown Diamond Jewelry](https://www.praguepost.com/lifestyle/special-occasions-lab-grown-diamond-jewelry): Guide to lab-grown diamonds and moissanite jewelry for special occasions
- [5 Surprising Ways Your Pet Affects Your Home's Cleanliness](https://www.praguepost.com/lifestyle/5-surprising-ways-your-pet-affects-your-homes-cleanliness): Article on pet ownership impact on home cleanliness and maintenance

## Business & Remote Work

- [Business - Prague Post](https://www.praguepost.com/business): Prague Post business section covering remote work and expat lifestyle
- [Street Sweeping for Gold: Gainesville Coins Highlights How Cities Are Mining Highways for Precious Metals](https://www.praguepost.com/business/street-sweeping-for-gold-gainesville-coins-highlights-how-cities-are-mining-highways-for-precious-metals): Gainesville Coins explores urban precious metals mining and recycling

## Fashion & Style

- [Pendants That Will Look Brilliant With Monotone Outfits](https://www.praguepost.com/style/pendants-look-brilliant-with-monotone-outfits): Fashion guide on styling pendant jewelry with monotone outfits
